criteria.text: All target-spec A1-A10 have matching evidence: primary chat and retained deep/manual paths; correct private thread/object continuity; shared avatar/channel/piece/variant/plan editors; same interview and review behavior; current dated-change research; real progress and safe recovery; accessible RU/EN dark/light responsive UI. Fresh chat-only reserve workflow and manual-to-chat-to-manual equality are recorded separately from model-free checks. Final release, actual owner/provider acceptance and production delivery are independent gates. No duplicate runtime, accidental publication, lost draft or changed historical acceptance.
